Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.tools.testing.mock.grid

Class MockGridConfig

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.tools.testing.mock.grid.MockGridConfig
public class MockGridConfig extends Object
Configuration for grid operations in mock mode. Provides default grid dimensions when SikuliX is not available.

The default 3x3 grid matches SikuliX's default raster configuration. Tests can override these values for specific test scenarios.

    • setDefaultGrid

      public static void setDefaultGrid(int rows, int cols)
      Sets the default grid dimensions for mock mode. These dimensions are used when calculating grid operations without SikuliX support.
      Parameters:
      rows - Number of rows in the grid (minimum 1)
      cols - Number of columns in the grid (minimum 1)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if rows or cols is less than 1
